question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s entrenched authority as CCP general secretary, Central Military Commission chairman, and state president underpins the 95.8% trader consensus against removal before 2027. Recent military leadership changes, including the 2026 investigation of senior figures, have further centralized control rather than signaling vulnerability, while elite appointments and policy continuity show no organized factional challenge. Major leadership transitions in China have historically aligned with scheduled party congresses, and the 21st Congress in 2027 is widely expected to extend Xi’s fourth term. Realistic scenarios that could still shift odds remain narrow, such as a sudden health event, severe economic dislocation prompting elite realignment, or an external crisis eroding internal cohesion before year-end 2026.
